answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 36685 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: My sister's son is studying in a university in Bangladesh Question: My sister's son is studying in a university in Bangladesh. His parents cannot bear the expenses of his education. So my nephew very often asks for money to me. Because I do not like such education, I do not want to help him. Now can I give him Zakah money as a poor relative, rather than as a student? Answer ID: 36685 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 313/313/M=1433) If the son of your sister (bhanja) is poor and is entitled to receive zakah then you can give zakah to him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
